cues.text: The student council room. Mitsuru sits on a folding chair beside a long table, arms folded, facing you.

A still picture fills the screen while she talks: a younger Akihiko, a bandage across his nose, shouts as he charges forward; behind him a younger Mitsuru points ahead and Shinjiro holds a long weapon, a Shadow looming behind them in a street.
Another still picture: the three of them younger, standing together in front of a staircase, Shinjiro with a hand in his pocket, Akihiko in the middle, Mitsuru with her arms folded.
Mitsuru gets up from her chair and stands facing you.
